name: tokenwise-vscode
description: Task-aware code context pruning for AI workflows using SWE-Pruner.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: TokenWise runs a local backend and installs executable workspace agent launchers.

tokenWise.pythonPath.description: Optional absolute path to a 64-bit Python 3.12 executable for managed backend setup. Leave empty to auto-detect it.

tokenWise.backendInstallationPath.description: Shared local TokenWise backend installation containing .venv, scripts, and swe-pruner. Set by Enable Automatic Context, never taken from repository settings.

tokenWise.autoOpenAutomaticContext.description: Show automatically prepared Antigravity context beside the editor without taking keyboard focus.

tokenWise.enableLocalGoalModel.description: Use an optional local OpenAI-compatible LLM to synthesize structured repository goals. When disabled, TokenWise uses its deterministic goal compiler without network calls.

tokenWise.localLlmUrl.description: Local goal synthesis LLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL (e.g. Ollama or LM Studio).

tokenWise.localLlmModelName.description: Model identifier for local goal generator LLM.

tokenWise.defaultThreshold.description: Default pruning threshold used in requests.

tokenWise.autoOpenResultPanel.description: Open TokenWise result panel automatically after each prune.

tokenWise.enableCarbonEstimation.description: Show approximate before/after carbon impact in manual and automatic context results. Automatic estimates load separately without delaying context retrieval.

tokenWise.targetModelName.description: Target LLM used for approximate energy/carbon estimation. The default is benchmark-backed and inside the interpolation range.

tokenWise.targetModelSizeB.description: Optional model-size assumption in billions. Zero or unset uses the backend registry/default assumption.

tokenWise.targetGpuType.description: Optional GPU assumption (e.g. nvidia-a100-80gb). Blank or unset uses the backend registry/default assumption.

tokenWise.expectedOutputTokens.description: Expected output token count used in prompt-level estimation.

tokenWise.latencyPerInputTokenMs.description: Optional prefill latency per input token in milliseconds. Zero or unset uses the backend registry/default assumption.

tokenWise.latencyPerOutputTokenMs.description: Optional decode latency per output token in milliseconds. Zero or unset uses the backend registry/default assumption.

tokenWise.carbonIntensityGPerKwh.description: Carbon intensity in grams CO2 per kWh for region-aware conversion.

tokenWise.repositoryTokenBudget.description: Maximum packed token budget for repository-context mode.

scripts.package: npm run prepare-backend && npm run compile && vsce package && node ../scripts/package-release.cjs
